_source: Store listings and the onboarding each role goes through in the app. The steps are the real sequence — a vendor and a rider both clear document verification before they can take anything.
_status: The listings are not published yet. `available: false` is what makes the page say so rather than link to a store page that 404s; flip it and fill in the URLs when they go live.

roles.title: Sell on QuickLocal
roles.blurb: List your shop, take orders from your own neighbourhood, and get paid to your bank.
highlights: Free to list — {freeProducts} products, no monthly cost
Your own free-delivery threshold, aisle by aisle
Paid after every delivered order, reconciled automatically
steps: Install the app and pick Vendor when you sign up
Enter your shop details and the category you sell in
Add a bank account or UPI id, then upload your documents
Add your products and open the shop

roles.title: Deliver with QuickLocal
roles.blurb: Choose the jobs that suit you, and see what each one pays — and how far it goes — before you accept it.
highlights: {base} for any delivery up to {freeKm} km
₹{perKm} more for every kilometre beyond it
The whole delivery fee, paid after every drop
steps: Install the app and pick Delivery Partner when you sign up
Tell us what you ride — it decides the papers you need
Add a bank account or UPI id, then upload your documents
Go online and start accepting jobs
